figures.finding: Colombian writers hold, under the Ley Pepe Sánchez (Ley 1835 de 2017), a non-waivable right to equitable remuneration paid by whoever communicates the work to the public, even after the presumed transfer of rights to the producer; it is collected by REDES (Red Colombiana de Escritores Audiovisuales), which began collecting and distributing in 2019. No guild agreement setting minimum writing fees was found (see blockers).

value.name: Red Colombiana de Escritores Audiovisuales (REDES)
value.right: equitable remuneration for public communication, making available and commercial rental

figures.applies: Colombia, writers of audiovisual works, from 2017 (collections from 2019).

sources.said: Estipula que en la presunción de cesión de los derechos de los autores, se conservará el derecho a recibir una remuneración equitativa por los actos de comunicación pública, incluida la puesta a disposición y el alquiler comercial al público que se hagan de la obra audiovisual, remuneración que será pagada directamente por quien realice la comunicación pública.

The law guarantees audiovisual authors—specifically directors and screenwriters—the right to receive payment when their works are publicly used for commercial purposes. This non-waivable remuneration must be managed collectively by entities created for this purpose such as DASC (Directores Audiovisuales Sociedad Colombiana de Gestión) and REDES (Red Colombiana de Escritores Audiovisuales), who began collecting and distributing rights in 2019.

figures.finding: The only published writing fee found is the FDC's: its 2026 call awards COP 25,000,000 per project for writing a fiction feature screenplay (COP 150,000,000 in all, so six awards), with a mentorship by an expert.

value.kind: public grant, not a guild minimum

figures.applies: Colombia; FDC 2026 competition, fiction feature screenwriting.

sources.said: El monto total es de ciento cincuenta millones de pesos ($150.000.000), con estímulos de veinticinco millones de pesos ($25.000.000) por proyecto. Adicionalmente, los proyectos beneficiarios recibirán una tutoría de escritura de guion con un experto.
